Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team reviewed the product and asked for the Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ package (completed responses) plus supporting evidence for Private (VPC) deployments — specifically network diagrams, KMS attestations, and SOC2 artifacts. Agnes —

Appreciate the clear ask and the fast follow. We're ready to provide a complete CAIQ response and a staged evidence delivery to match your procurement timeline. High-level plan:

- Phase A (48 business hours): Completed CAIQ response (with owner annotations).
- Phase B (3–5 business days): Evidence bundle (network diagram, KMS integration notes, SOC2 summary, relevant logs/sample artifacts).
- Phase C (as-needed): Deeper artifacts (config exports, runbooks) under an NDA/secure share.

Marissa (Security Engineering) will lead evidence collation; Laura from Trust Ops will attach SOC2 summary and controls crosswalk; Karthik will provide the VPC diagram and KMS details. I'll coordinate delivery and provide a HubSpot record + secure Drive link.

Is the procurement cutoff next Wednesday (4/28) still accurate? If so, we'll prioritize Phase A+B for that date.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0194

Hi all —

Acknowledged. Quick notes from Security Engineering:

1) CAIQ responses: we'll mark owner for each control and include references to source artifacts (policy doc ids / internal playbooks). Expect the CAIQ CSV/PDF in Phase A.

2) KMS + key management: we use customer-managed keys (optional) via Cloud KMS integrations; I'll include a KMS integration diagram and the public attestation checklist. For on-prem HSM deployments we have a separate workflow — let me know if Pinecrest needs that.

3) Network diagram: Karthik will attach the VPC topology with the control plane / data plane separation callouts.

4) SOC2: Laura will attach a one-page SOC2 summary and a proposed evidence set for audit sampling.

5) Data residency: Redwood's hosted US regions keep customer data in the requested region; we'll add the specific commitment language and controls referencing encryption-in-transit and at-rest.

I will deliver Phase A by EOD 2027-04-22 and Phase B by 2027-04-26 if procurement needs the full evidence set.

—Marissa
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
